heading: EXT. THE MARKET ON MOSSBACK'S SHELL - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. THE MARKET ON MOSSBACK'S SHELL - NIGHT
A giant tortoise the size of a hill wades through a silver-grass plain under three moons.
Lanterns hang from its shell ridges like fruit.
Stalls of woven reeds, hanging spices, strings of glowing beetles.
The air smells of smoke and honey.
IXCHEL VANTH, thirties, a spice merchant in a feathered shawl, weighs saffron on a brass scale.
BRAM OSSERY, twenties, a young knight with a scuffed breastplate, leans on her counter pretending to browse.
THISBE, ageless, a street-musician, plays a hollow-bone flute under a lantern.
ULAANA KHAN, forties, in a fur-lined cloak, inspects a jar of black pepper held to the light.
Three silver for the saffron.
units.name: IXCHEL

units.text: Two.
units.name: BRAM

units.text: Three, and you pay for the staring.
units.name: IXCHEL

units.text: Bram drops his eyes to the scale.
Ulaana lowers the jar and watches him across the stall.
Thisbe's flute dips into a minor key.
You're far from the capital, sir knight.
units.name: ULAANA

units.text: I'm on holiday.
units.name: BRAM

units.text: Wearing the king's crest.
units.name: ULAANA

units.text: He shifts.
His cloak falls over the crest.
Ixchel slides the scale an inch to the left, away from his hand.
Ulaana. He's a boy.
units.name: IXCHEL

units.text: He's a boy with a king's seal in his pocket.
units.name: ULAANA

units.text: Bram's fingers move toward his belt.
Thisbe stops playing.
For a moment the market's murmur is the only sound.
A deep note rolls beneath their feet, the long slow call of the tortoise itself.
I feel four hearts quicken on my back. Who has a secret?
units.name: MOSSBACK

units.text: Everyone stills.
Lanterns sway.
Thisbe lowers the flute and bows to the ground.
Great One. Nobody speaks.
units.name: THISBE

units.text: Then I will walk slower.
units.name: MOSSBACK

units.text: The ground shudders and settles.
Ixchel moves first, slowly, and sets the scale on the counter.
Two silver and a half.
units.name: IXCHEL

units.text: That's robbery.
units.name: BRAM

units.text: That's the price of silence.
units.name: IXCHEL

units.text: He pays.
She wraps the saffron in a leaf, holds it out.
He takes it without meeting her eyes.
Ulaana sets down the pepper jar and turns away, her cloak flaring, and walks into the crowd.
Thisbe lifts the flute and begins a new tune, bright and quick, as if nothing had happened.
